title: Carvera Community Firmware command reference
notes: Keys are command IDs: G0, M3, M490.1, ls, $J.
parameters.<name>.default is a number, string, or null when there is no fixed default.
default_source names a config key when the default comes from configuration.
3D-printer leftovers are listed because the firmware still parses them; they are not used on Carvera.

G0.description: Rapid move to the programmed position. F on this line applies only to this move; without F the configured default seek rate is used, not the last G1 feed.

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

F.description: Feed for this G0 line only.

G1.description: Linear move at the modal feed rate (mm/min in G94, inverse time in G93).

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

F.description: Feed rate. Modal in G94; required on every G1/G2/G3 line in G93.

G2.description: Clockwise arc in the selected plane to XYZ, rotating about the IJK offset from the start point.

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

I.description: Arc center offset along the first plane axis.

J.description: Arc center offset along the second plane axis.

K.description: Arc center offset along the third plane axis.

F.description: Feed rate. Modal in G94; required in G93.

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

I.description: Arc center offset along the first plane axis.

J.description: Arc center offset along the second plane axis.

K.description: Arc center offset along the third plane axis.

F.description: Feed rate. Modal in G94; required in G93.

G4.description: Dwell for P seconds before continuing.

G10.description: Set a workspace coordinate offset (LinuxCNC-style G10 L2/L20).

L.description: 2 set WCS origin from current coordinates; 20 set WCS so current position becomes the given values.

P.description: Workspace number: 1 is G54, 2 is G55, and so on.

A.description: A offset or coordinate.

G17.description: Select the XY plane for arcs (modal).

G18.description: Select the XZ plane for arcs (modal).

G19.description: Select the YZ plane for arcs (modal).

G20.description: Inch mode. Community firmware currently halts if this is used because of known issues.

G21.description: Millimeter mode (default). Coordinates are treated as millimeters.

G28.description: Go to the configured clearance position.

G29.description: Probe a grid starting at the current XY position. Not used for level compensation.

X.description: Distance of grid in X direction

Y.description: Distance of grid in Y direction

I.description: Number of grid points in X

J.description: Number of grid points in Y

G30.description: Simple Z probe. Probes downwards and reports the trigger position.

Z.description: If given, set current Z to this value after a successful probe (G92 Z).

R.description: Non-zero probes in the reverse Z direction.

G31.description: Grid probe report, and enable leveling compensation (same family as G32).

G32.description: Probe a grid and enable bed compensation until reset or M370.

A.description: Grid width.

I.description: Number of points in X.

G33.description: Record an X-axis flex profile and enable flex compensation.

I.description: Number of sample intervals.

G38.2.description: Probe toward the workpiece and stop on contact. Halts with an error if the probe does not trigger.

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

G38.3.description: Probe toward the workpiece and stop on contact. Does not halt if the probe does not trigger.

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

G38.4.description: Probe away from the workpiece and stop on loss of contact. Halts if contact is not lost.

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

G38.5.description: Probe away from the workpiece and stop on loss of contact. Does not halt on failure.

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

G38.6.description: Calibrate-Z style probe. Hard-disabled in Community firmware.

G53.description: Next move uses machine coordinates. Must be alone or the first G code on the line, followed by G0/G1.

G92.description: Set the G92 offset so the current position reports as the given coordinates.

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

G92.4.description: Manually set machine (MCS) position for the given axes. G92.4 A0 S0 shrinks A back into 0–360 for continuous rotary work.

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

S.description: With A0, shrink the A axis into 0–360 range.

G93.description: Inverse-time feed mode. On every G1/G2/G3, F is 1/minutes for that block and is required.

G94.description: Feed per minute mode (default relative to G93). F is mm/min.

M1.description: Optional stop. Pauses file playback only when optional-stop mode is enabled with M334.

M2.description: End of program. Stops the spindle and air assist and ends playback.

M3.description: Start the spindle clockwise. Requires a valid tool in the spindle. In laser mode this turns the laser on instead.

M4.description: Start the spindle counter-clockwise when the spindle implementation supports direction.

M5.description: Stop the spindle (or laser). Also turns off vacuum/ext-out if those follow-spindle modes are on.

M6.description: Tool change. T0 is the wireless probe, T-1 is empty spindle, T1+ is a tool number. After the change the machine usually runs TLO calibration unless disabled.

T.description: Tool number to change to. Special numbers are 0 probe, -1 none, 999990 3D Probe

S.description: Collet type 1–6. On an ATC machine, move to the manual tool-change position first so the collet can be swapped.

R.description: Repeat TLO measurement to find lowest point (for example on a face mill).

H.description: Custom TLO value. Skips automatic TLO calibration and uses this value.

C.description: 1 run automatic TLO after the change, 0 skip it.

M7.description: Start air flow on air assist.

M17.description: Enable all stepper drivers for debug purposes

M18.description: Disable stepper drivers. With no axis letters, all motors are turned off.

A.description: Disable A if present.

M20.description: List files at the SD card root. Does not recurse into subfolders.

M21.description: Dummy SD-init command for Octoprint compatibility. Does nothing.

M23.description: Select a G-code file on the SD card without starting it.

filename.description: Path relative to the SD card, written after M23.

M24.description: Start playing the currently selected file.

M25.description: Pause the currently playing file. Prefer M600 for a controlled suspend.

M26.description: Reset the current file so it is ready to start over.

M27.description: Report playback progress (Marlin-style), used to sync the controller display.

M30.description: End of program in grbl-style mode. As an SD command it can also delete a file; on Carvera treat M2 as the normal program end.

filename.description: File to delete when used as an SD remove command.

M32.description: Select a file and start playing it. For macros prefer M98.

filename.description: Path of the file to play.

M82.description: Extruder absolute mode. Inherited 3D-printer command; not used on Carvera.

M83.description: Extruder relative mode. Inherited 3D-printer command; not used on Carvera.

M84.description: Disable all stepper drivers (same as M18 with no axes).

M92.description: Set steps per millimeter for the given axes. Without values, reports current steps/mm.

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

M98.description: Run a macro file, then return with M99.

M97.description: Related macro/call helper used with file playback.

M99.description: Return from a macro to the main program.

M112.description: Emergency stop. Halts the machine immediately.

M114.description: Report position. Subcodes select WCS, realtime WCS, machine, actuator, or last milestone.
M114.notes: M114.1 realtime WCS, M114.2 realtime MCS, M114.3 actuator, M114.4 last milestone, M114.5 extra.

M117.description: Display the rest of the line as a message. Non-standard: arbitrary text follows the command.

M118.description: Print the rest of the line to the console/host. Non-standard: arbitrary text follows the command.

M119.description: Report endstop and probe pin states.

M120.description: Push current motion state (mode, feed, WCS) onto a stack.

M121.description: Pop the motion state saved by M120.

M143.description: Set maximum hotend temperature. 3D-printer leftover; no Carvera function.

M203.description: Set or report maximum feedrates in mm/s. M203.1 sets maximum actuator feedrates.

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.
Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

M204.description: Set default acceleration. S sets the default; X Y Z set per-axis acceleration.

M205.description: Set planner junction deviation and minimum planner speed.

M206.description: Set homing offsets for the given axes.

A.description: Target or offset on A (rotary), if present.

M211.description: Turn software endstops on or off.

M220.description: Feed-rate override as a percentage of programmed feed.

M221.description: Documented in some tables as soft endstops; Community firmware uses M211 for that. Treat M221 as unused on Carvera unless a host sends it.

M223.description: Spindle-speed override as a percentage. Clamped to 10–300%.

M301.description: Set hotend PID. 3D-printer leftover; no Carvera function.

M303.description: PID autotune. 3D-printer leftover; no Carvera function.

M304.description: PID autotune helper. 3D-printer leftover; no Carvera function.

M305.description: Thermistor sensor settings. 3D-printer leftover; no Carvera function.

M306.description: Set homing offset from the current position.

M321.description: Enter laser mode. Drops the current tool and calibrates TLO against the collet so the laser offset matches the work surface.

M322.description: Exit laser mode and return to CNC mode.

M323.description: Enter laser test mode with very low power, used for refocusing the laser's lense.

M331.description: Enable auto chip clearing following the spindle on/off state. On C1 this is the vacuum; on CA1 and Z1 it is the external output.

M331.1.description: Enable auto blow on Z1. The spindle fan will always run with this minimum power while the spindle is on.

M331.2.description: Runs a cleaning cycle when gcode playback finishes.

M331.4.description: Turn on the ionizer on Z1.

M332.description: Disable auto chip clearing (C1: vacuum, CA1/Z1: External Output pin).

M332.2.description: Disable automatic bed cleaning after jobs.

M333.description: Disable optional-stop mode. M1 will not pause.

M334.description: Enable optional-stop mode. M1 will pause playback.

M335.description: Related optional-stop / line-by-line helper. See line-by-line execution docs.

M336.description: Related optional-stop / line-by-line helper. See line-by-line execution docs.

M337.description: Set the LED bar color. (Works on all machines except for Carvera C1)

M370.description: Clear auto bed-leveling data and disable compensation until G32 is run again.

M374.description: Save the autoleveling grid to the SD card.

M374.1.description: Delete the saved autoleveling grid from the SD card.

M375.description: Load the autoleveling grid from the SD card.

M375.1.description: Print the current bed-leveling grid to the console.

M400.description: Wait until all queued moves have finished before running the next command.

M460.description: Calibrate the 3D probe tip. Default is against a bore of known diameter.

X.description: Known diameter or X size of the feature.

Y.description: Known Y size. Defaults to X if omitted.

I.description: Invert probe for NC.

M481.description: Wi-Fi diagnostic / connection query. Prefer the wlan and ap console commands.

M485.description: Report the current communication protocol mode.

M489.description: Query Wi-Fi module status. Prefer diagnose or wlan commands.

M490.description: ATC home. Homing runs automatically when M490.1 or M490.2 needs it.

M490.1.description: Tighten the spindle collet to secure a tool.

M490.2.description: Loosen the spindle collet and drop the current tool.

M490.3.description: ATC helper used in tool-change scripts (clamp/unclamp sequencing).

M491.description: Calibrate TLO for the current tool on the tool setter.

M491.2.description: TLO calibration with explicit tolerance/value used by internal scripts.

M492.description: Internal: check whether the tool rack slot is empty.

M493.description: Set or report the current tool number / TLO state.

M493.1.description: Internal: set or report a tool-rack slot.

M493.2.description: Set the active tool number without a full M6 cycle.

M493.5.description: ATC pause / wait-for-user during a tool change.

M494.description: Turn on the probe / detector laser.

M494.1.description: Turn on the probe laser (script alias).

M495.description: Controller automation: Runs one or more of these: margin, Z-probe, and/or auto-level from a path origin.

O.description: Z-probe X offset. With F, XY offset probe; without F, absolute Z probe.

A.description: Leveling width (with B, I, J, H).

I.description: Leveling grid X count.

R.description: If present, use the rotary-safe path movement to work origin.

M498.2.description: Erase EEPROM data. Do not run unless you intend to wipe stored offsets.

M500.description: Save volatile settings (including overrides that modules register) to config-override on the SD card.

M502.description: Delete config-override so the next boot uses only config.txt defaults.

M503.description: Print live settings and show whether an override file is present.

M504.description: Save settings to a named override file.

filename.description: Override file name after the command.

M565.description: Set Z-probe XYZ offsets used by leveling strategies.

M575.description: Endstop repeatability test. Homes, taps each selected endstop, and reports trigger scatter.

A.description: Include A.

M576.description: Verify MD5 sidecars for uploaded files under /sd/gcodes/.

M600.1.description: Suspend playback and leave heaters on. Doesn't do anything special on non-3D Printers

M600.5.description: Internal suspend marker used in ATC scripts.

M601.description: Resume a suspended program. Same idea as the resume console command.

M665.description: Set optional arm-solution variables. Delta leftover; not used on Carvera kinematics.

M670.description: Temporarily set probe feed and height defaults until reset.

I.description: Invert probe.

M801.description: Turn on the internal vacuum (C1) or the PSU fan (CA1).

M802.description: Turn off the vacuum (C1) or PSU fan (CA1).

M811.description: Turn on the spindle cooling fan.

M812.description: Turn off the spindle cooling fan.

M831.description: Turn on the tool-detector sensor laser.

M832.description: Turn off the tool-detector sensor laser.

M851.description: Turn on the extended output / external vacuum.

M852.description: Turn off the extended output / external vacuum.

M881.description: Set the 2.4 GHz wireless-probe channel and start transmitting.

M882.description: Turn off the wireless-probe radio / related 2.4 GHz transmit.

M885.description: Turn off hard endstops until the next power cycle. Ignored while homing.

M889.description: ATC/home-check related helper used with M887/M888.

M890.description: ATC/public-data helper related to home or tool checks.

M891.description: ATC/public-data helper related to home or tool checks.

M957.description: Report current spindle speed and on/off status.

M958.description: Set spindle PID terms and report the current settings. Doesn't seem to actually be implemented

I.description: Integral term.

M999.description: Clear a halt / alarm lock so motion commands are accepted again. Home afterwards; position is unknown.

M1000.description: Pass the rest of the line, lowercased, to SimpleShell. For hosts that cannot send raw shell commands.

ls.description: List files in a directory on the SD card.

-e.description: End the listing with an EOF marker for host transfers.

folder.description: Directory to list. Defaults to the current working directory.

echo.description: Echo the rest of the line back to the host.

break.description: Break into the debugger (MRI), if enabled in the build.

?.description: Same as help when typed as a shell command. As a single control character it is the status query.

ftype.description: Print the file types accepted for upload.

get.description: Query machine state. The first word selects what to print.

what.description: One of: pos, wcs, state, status, fk, ik, temp, compensation, wp, msc.

-m.description: With fk/ik, also move to the computed position.

switch.description: Get or set a named switch (light, vacuum, air, and others).

name.description: Switch name (light, vacuum, air, and others).

value.description: 0/1 or on/off. Omit to read the current state.

ap.description: Control the machine Wi-Fi access point.

ssid.description: ap ssid <name> changes the AP name.

password.description: ap password <text> sets the AP password.

enable.description: ap enable turns the AP on.

disable.description: ap disable turns the AP off.

channel.description: Optional channel when used as ap <channel>.

wlan.description: Scan, connect, or disconnect to a Wi-Fi network.

ssid.description: Network name. Omit with no other args to scan.

-d.description: Disconnect from the current STA network.

diagnose.description: Print diagnostic status including spindle, laser, switches, endstops, probe, ATC pins, e-stop, and Wi-Fi.

sleep.description: Cut 12 V/24 V supplies and put the controller to sleep (halt).

power.description: Control machine power rails used by sleep/wake.

calc_thermistor.description: Calculate Steinhart–Hart coefficients from three T,R points.

md5sum.description: Print the MD5 of a file. Does not compare to upload sidecars; use M576 for that.

time.description: Print the controller clock as a timestamp.

model.description: Print or identify the machine model.

fset.description: Write a factory-setting bit. Service command.

baud.description: Query or temporarily set the USB serial baud rate. The new rate reverts to the configured default after 15 s with no serial traffic.

rate.description: Baud rate, 1–4000000. Omit to print the current rate.

debugmode.description: Enable firmware diagnostic output as real time console messages.

source.description: Usually sd. Optional; defaults to the writable config source.

setting.description: Settings key name, for example acceleration.

config-set.description: Write one configuration key to a writable source (typically the SD config).

config-delete.description: Remove a key line from a writable config source.

config-get-all.description: Dump keys from a config file.

config-restore.description: Restore configuration from a backup/restore path used by the controller.

play.description: Play a G-code file. The machine must be homed.

progress.description: Show progress of the file currently playing.

abort.description: Stop file playback and clear the queue.

goto.description: After pausing a job, jump playback to a line number in the file.

buffer.description: Queue a G-code line into the player buffer.

upload.description: Receive a stream and save it as the named file.

download.description: Send a file to the host.

$G.description: Print modal state (same as get state).

$I.description: Print modal state for smoopi-style hosts (same as get state, no trailing ok).

$X.description: Unlock after a halt (same idea as M999).

$H.description: Home. Unlocks first if halted. In grbl mode this issues G28.2; otherwise G28.

$J.description: Jog. Incremental unless -c is given, which starts continuous jog that needs keep-alives and ^Y to stop.

-c.description: Continuous jog until stop or keep-alive timeout.

-r.description: Send ok when finished (for $J in a file).

axis.description: One or more of Xn Yn Zn An Bn Cn. Sign chooses direction; magnitude is used as a step or direction for continuous.

S.description: Speed as a scale of the axis max rate.

F.description: Feed in mm/min. Overrides S if both are given.
